title: The Smothered Knight Mate
commentary: White to play and mate in 2 moves!
First, White plays a brilliant Queen sacrifice with Qg8 check!
Rook is forced to capture on g8, smothering their own King.
And Knight to f7 is a beautiful smothered checkmate!

title: The Opera Game Queen Sacrifice
commentary: Morphy's famous Opera Game position. White to move and mate in 2!
White launches a stunning Queen sacrifice with Qb8 check!
Black is forced to take the Queen with Knight to b8.
And Rook to d8 delivers back-rank checkmate!

title: Giuoco Piano Tactical Trap
commentary: A classic center fork trick in the Italian Opening!
White sacrifices the Knight with Nxe5!
After Black recaptures with Nxe5, White plays d4 forking both Bishop and Knight!
White regains the piece with central control.
